## filter to 96 strains
```{}
cd /projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/the_vcfs/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls
module load bioinformatics/20260810

# build keep file (FID IID); AVI is stored as "AVI 1a" in this .fam
awk 'NF{ if($1=="AVI" && $2=="AVI") $2="1a"; print $1, $2 }' \
    /projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/the_vcfs/sample_used_split.txt \
    > CNVs_96_strains/keep_96_strains.txt

plink --bfile full1086.CNVs.MAC1.plink \
      --keep CNVs_96_strains/keep_96_strains.txt \
      --allow-extra-chr \
      --make-bed \
      --out CNVs_96_strains/CNVs.96strains.plink

```
##### filter to maf 15 for 96 strains
```{}
cd /projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/the_vcfs/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/CNVs_96_strains

plink --bfile CNVs.96strains.plink \
```

#Strip chromosome from chromosome column of .bim file
```{}
V=/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/the_vcfs

# 1. Chromosome names: strip the "chromosome" prefix from column 1 of each .bim that has it
BIMS=$(find $V/vcf_files_from_3034_natural_isolates_of_S.cerevisiae_victor_2024 \
            $V/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/SVs_1087 \
            $V/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/CNVs_96_strains -name "*.bim")

for b in $BIMS; do
    if cut -f1 $b | grep -q "^chromosome"; then
        cp -p $b $b.orig
        awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS="\t"} {sub(/^chromosome/, "", $1)} 1' $b.orig > $b
    fi
done

# 2. AVI: rename "AVI 1a" -> "AVI AVI" in the 96-strain CNV and SV .fam files
for f in $V/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/CNVs_96_strains/CNVs.96strains.plink.fam \
         $V/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/CNVs_96_strains/CNV_96strains_maf15/CNVs.96strains.maf15.plink.fam \
         $V/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/SVs_1087/SVs_96/SV.96strains.plink.fam \
         $V/structural_variant_vcf/SVcalls2/SVcalls/SVs_1087/SVs_96/SV_96_maf_15/SV.96strains.maf15.plink.fam; do
    cp -p $f $f.orig
    awk '{ if ($1=="AVI" && $2=="1a") $2="AVI"; print }' $f.orig > $f
done

```
